content.text: The focused tests and TypeScript check pass, but adversarial inputs have exposed two real boundary/cap problems: common abbreviations can become chunk boundaries, and some ordinary whitespace-separated text can exceed the advertised character cap. I’m finishing the remaining category checks and deduplicating their overlap.
